ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: this is a contour topographic map. In the lower right corner, two adjacent contour lines can be seen marked 800 and 850 respectively; in the upper left there is mountain peak J, located within a closed contour line; in the upper right there is mountain peak k, and nearby there is a cliff symbol m; at m, multiple contour lines can be seen overlapping at the cliff symbol, and according to the number of overlapping lines on the map, there are 3. Reasoning: from the two adjacent contour lines 800 m and 850 m in the lower right corner, it can be known that the contour interval d=50 m. Tracing along the contour lines, the closed contour line where mountain peak J is located and the closed contour line where mountain peak k is located differ by one contour interval, and can be read as J being about between 950—1000 m and k being about between 1000—1050 m; therefore the maximum possible height difference between mountain peak k and mountain peak J is less than 100 m. At cliff m, n=3 contour lines overlap, and the formula for relative height of a cliff is (n-1)d≤H<(n+1)d, so the height of m is at least (3-1)×50=100 m. Since the minimum possible height of cliff m, 100 m, is still greater than the maximum possible value of the height difference between mountain peak k and mountain peak J (less than 100 m), the height of cliff m is greater than the height difference between mountain peak k and mountain peak J.

method.method_draft: 先根据右下角800和850两条相邻等高线求得等高距d=50 m。然后沿等高线走向给左上山峰J、右上山峰k所在闭合等高线赋值，得到两个峰顶的可能高度区间，并计算山峰k与山峰J的最大可能高差。再在断崖m处数重合的等高线条数n，用断崖高度公式求出m的最小可能高度。最后比较两个区间：若m的最小高度仍大于k、J高差的最大值，则回答断崖m的高度大于山峰k和山峰J的高差。
method.CoT_raw:

推理：由右下角800 m与850 m两条相邻等高线可知等高距d=50 m。沿等高线追踪，山峰J所在闭合等高线与山峰k所在闭合等高线相差一个等高距，可读为J约在950—1000 m之间，k约在1000—1050 m之间，因此山峰k与山峰J的最大可能高差小于100 m。断崖m处有n=3条等高线重合，断崖相对高度公式为(n-1)d≤H<(n+1)d，所以m的高度至少为(3-1)×50=100 m。由于断崖m的最小可能高度100 m仍大于山峰k与山峰J高差的最大可能值（小于100 m），所以断崖m的高度大于山峰k和山峰J的高差。
